contract.note: 1280×720 屏幕固定背景：岩体深处，无天空/星/地平线

prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. Materials: rounded chunky natural cave rock; local palette: muted mist-green wet stone, sparse moss, subtle bell-shaped details. Wide 16:9 enclosed underground backdrop, dim blue-violet or dark teal depths. Large rounded cave walls and a sealed overhead ceiling visible along upper edge, layered distant enclosed chambers, very low contrast so gameplay in front remains readable. No focal object, no strong light spots, no floor stage in foreground. No sky, stars, horizon, window, sunbeam, outside trees, outdoor scenery or opening to sky. Lit only by faint indirect subterranean mineral glow. Flat color planes; leave middle dark and quiet.
